inputs.text: Healthcare workers in Nigeria are pushing back against controversial reform bills before the National Assembly, and the establishment’s attempt to present these changes as ordinary legislation shouldn’t fool anyone. Their protest at Unity Fountain in Abuja suggests the people who understand the health sector best see these bills as a threat. When workers from the Joint Health Sector Unions and the Assembly of Healthcare Professional Associations speak out together, it’s worth asking whose interests these reforms really serve—and why those interests are being advanced despite the warning signs.
